verdict.wrong_value: str(mpf('inf')) / nstr(mp.mpf('inf')) returned '+inf' with a leading plus sign instead of 'inf'
verdict.rationale: The defect concerns the special value infinity: formatting/rendering of mpf('inf') emitted '+inf' rather than 'inf', as asserted by the new test (str(mpf('inf')) == 'inf'). This is a mishandled special-value representation (sign prefix on Inf), analogous to lost signed-zero formatting, so it falls under special_value. The concrete numeric value is not changed, hence only moderate confidence.
